g.text: Select sound groups to back up
All groups (INT, Card A, Card B)
Note: CARDA/CARDB sounds/presets can only be backed up
if the card is present and the unit can read them.
Preset names are the unit's own and are not restored
by a dump; local labels are copied beside the dump as
a sidecar. The effect block needs the panel's
